# Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison

## Overview
Four datasets capture different dimensions of water stress for 10 countries spanning arid, semi-arid, and water-rich regions. Together they enable a composite view of regional water crisis severity.

## Data Source

### water_supply_demand
Fields: `country` (string), `iso` (ISO 3166 alpha-3), `supply_demand_ratio` (float, renewable supply ÷ total withdrawal; values 0.31–6.12), `stress_class` (categorical: Extremely High / High / Medium-High / Medium / Low). Year: 2023 estimate.

### per_capita_freshwater
Fields: `country` (string), `per_capita_m3` (integer, cubic meters per person per year; range 84–80,620). Year: 2023 estimate. The 1,000 m³ threshold is commonly used to indicate water scarcity.

### groundwater_extraction
Fields: `country` (string), `extraction_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `recharge_km3_yr` (float, km³/year), `extraction_recharge_ratio` (float; values 0.05–5.66). Ratio > 1.0 signals overdraft. Year: 2023 estimate.

### precipitation_trends

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.gridspec as gridspec
import numpy as np
import json

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Extract data, ordered by supply_demand_ratio (most stressed first)
sd = sorted(data['water_supply_demand']['data'], key=lambda x: x['supply_demand_ratio'])
countries = [d['country'] for d in sd]
sd_ratio = [d['supply_demand_ratio'] for d in sd]
stress_class = [d['stress_class'] for d in sd]

pc_map = {d['country']: d['per_capita_m3'] for d in data['per_capita_freshwater']['data']}
gw_map = {d['country']: d for d in data['groundwater_extraction']['data']}
precip_map = {}
for d in data['precipitation_trends']['data']:
    precip_map.setdefault(d['country'], {})[d['decade']] = d['mean_precip_mm']

per_capita = [pc_map[c] for c in countries]
gw_ratio = [gw_map[c]['extraction_recharge_ratio'] for c in countries]
precip_change = [(precip_map[c]['2010s'] - precip_map[c]['1990s']) / precip_map[c]['1990s'] * 100 for c in countries]

# Color scheme
stress_colors = {
    'Extremely High': '#b71c1c',
    'High': '#e65100',
    'Medium-High': '#f9a825',
    'Medium': '#1565c0',
    'Low': '#2e7d32',
}
bar_colors = [stress_colors[sc] for sc in stress_class]

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 14), facecolor='#fafafa')
fig.suptitle('Global Water Stress: Multi-Indicator Country Comparison (2023)',
             fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.97, color='#1a1a2e')
fig.text(0.5, 0.94, 'Countries ordered by water supply-to-demand ratio (most stressed → least stressed)',
         ha='center', fontsize=11, color='#555', style='italic')

gs = gridspec.GridSpec(2, 2, hspace=0.38, wspace=0.32, left=0.08, right=0.95, top=0.90, bottom=0.06)
y_pos = np.arange(len(countries))

# --- Panel A: Supply/Demand Ratio ---
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
bars = ax1.barh(y_pos, sd_ratio, color=bar_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.7)
ax1.axvline(x=1.0, color='#c62828', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.8, label='Demand = Supply')
ax1.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax1.set_yticklabels(countries, fontsize=10)
ax1.set_xlabel('Supply ÷ Demand Ratio', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('A. Water Supply-to-Demand Ratio', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(sd_ratio):
    ax1.text(v + 0.08, i, f'{v:.2f}', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#333')
ax1.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
ax1.set_xlim(0, max(sd_ratio) * 1.15)
ax1.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Panel B: Per-Capita Freshwater (log scale) ---
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
bars2 = ax2.barh(y_pos, per_capita, color=bar_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.7)
ax2.axvline(x=1000, color='#c62828', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.8, label='Scarcity threshold (1,000 m³)')
ax2.set_xscale('log')
ax2.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax2.set_yticklabels(countries, fontsize=10)
ax2.set_xlabel('m³ per person per year (log scale)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('B. Per-Capita Freshwater Availability', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left')
ax2.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(per_capita):
    ax2.text(v * 1.15, i, f'{v:,.0f}', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#333')
ax2.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Panel C: Groundwater Extraction/Recharge Ratio ---
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
gw_colors = ['#b71c1c' if r > 1.0 else '#e65100' if r > 0.75 else '#2e7d32' for r in gw_ratio]
bars3 = ax3.barh(y_pos, gw_ratio, color=gw_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.7)
ax3.axvline(x=1.0, color='#c62828', linestyle='--', linewidth=1.5, alpha=0.8, label='Overdraft threshold')
ax3.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax3.set_yticklabels(countries, fontsize=10)
ax3.set_xlabel('Extraction ÷ Recharge Ratio', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('C. Groundwater Extraction vs. Recharge', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left')
ax3.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(gw_ratio):
    label = f'{v:.2f}'
    if v > 1.0:
        label += ' ⚠'
    ax3.text(v + 0.08, i, label, va='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#333')
ax3.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
ax3.set_xlim(0, max(gw_ratio) * 1.12)
ax3.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# --- Panel D: Precipitation Trend ---
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
precip_colors = ['#b71c1c' if p < -5 else '#e65100' if p < 0 else '#2e7d32' for p in precip_change]
bars4 = ax4.barh(y_pos, precip_change, color=precip_colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5, height=0.7)
ax4.axvline(x=0, color='#555', linestyle='-', linewidth=1, alpha=0.5)
ax4.set_yticks(y_pos)
ax4.set_yticklabels(countries, fontsize=10)
ax4.set_xlabel('Change in Mean Precipitation, 1990s→2010s (%)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('D. Decadal Precipitation Trend', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', loc='left')
ax4.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(precip_change):
    ha = 'left' if v >= 0 else 'right'
    offset = 0.3 if v >= 0 else -0.3
    ax4.text(v + offset, i, f'{v:+.1f}%', va='center', fontsize=8.5, color='#333', ha=ha)
ax4.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax4.spines['right'].set_visible(False)

# Legend for stress classes
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor=stress_colors[k], label=k) for k in
                   ['Extremely High', 'High', 'Medium-High', 'Medium', 'Low']]
fig.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower center', ncol=5, fontsize=9,
           title='Water Stress Classification', title_fontsize=10,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 0.005), frameon=True, edgecolor='#ccc')

fig.text(0.98, 0.005, 'Data: FAO AQUASTAT / WRI Aqueduct (2023 est.)', ha='right', fontsize=7, color='#999')

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='#fafafa')
print('Done')
